spans.text: [6] AR: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا EN: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.

[18] AR: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًۭا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌۭ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَٰسِطٌۭ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًۭا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًۭا EN: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep.

folded.subject: Allah
folded.object: taken a son

spans.text: [4] AR: وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا EN: And to warn those who say, "Allah has taken a son."

folded.id: and never|would|you succeed
folded.subject: And never
folded.object: you succeed

spans.text: And never would you succeed, then - ever."

folded.id: and we|increased|them in guidance
folded.subject: and We
folded.object: them in guidance

spans.text: Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

folded.id: and we|made|firm their hearts when they stood up and said
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: firm their hearts when they stood up and said

spans.text: [14] AR: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهًۭا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًۭا شَطَطًا EN: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth.

folded.id: and we|turned|them to the right and to the left
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: them to the right and to the left

spans.text: And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance.

folded.id: and who|is|more unjust than one who invents about allah a lie?"
folded.subject: And who
folded.object: more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie?"

spans.text: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie?"

folded.id: grave|is|the word that comes out of their mouths
folded.subject: Grave
folded.object: the word that comes out of their mouths

spans.text: Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

folded.id: he has|made|it] straight
folded.subject: He has
folded.object: it] straight

spans.text: [2] AR: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا EN: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

folded.id: how long|have|you remained [here]?"
folded.subject: How long
folded.object: you remained [here]?"

spans.text: Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?"

folded.id: it|is|we who relate to you
folded.subject: It
folded.object: We who relate to you

spans.text: [13] AR: نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَٰهُمْ هُدًۭى EN: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth.

folded.id: never|will|we invoke besides him any deity
folded.subject: Never
folded.object: we invoke besides Him any deity

spans.text: Never will we invoke besides Him any deity.

folded.id: never|will|you find for him a protecting guide
folded.subject: never
folded.object: you find for him a protecting guide

spans.text: He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.

folded.id: or|have|you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were

spans.text: [9] AR: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا EN: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?

folded.id: our lord|is|the lord of the heavens and the earth
folded.subject: Our Lord
folded.object: the Lord of the heavens and the earth

spans.text: [14] AR: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهًۭا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًۭا شَطَطًا EN: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth.

folded.id: perhaps you|would|kill yourself through grief over them
folded.subject: perhaps you
folded.object: kill yourself through grief over them

spans.text: [6] AR: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا EN: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.

[18] AR: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًۭا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌۭ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَٰسِطٌۭ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًۭا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًۭا EN: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep.

folded.id: praise|is|[due] to allah
folded.subject: praise
folded.object: [due] to Allah

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.

folded.id: so we|cast|[a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years
folded.subject: So We
folded.object: [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years

spans.text: [11] AR: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ فِى ٱلْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًۭا EN: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.

folded.id: that they|will|have a good reward
folded.subject: that they
folded.object: have a good reward

spans.text: [2] AR: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا EN: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

folded.id: then we|awakened|them that we might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time
folded.subject: Then We
folded.object: them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time

spans.text: [12] AR: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓا۟ أَمَدًۭا EN: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.

[19] AR: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًۭا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍۢ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا EN: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another.

folded.id: they|have|no knowledge of it
folded.subject: They
folded.object: no knowledge of it

spans.text: [5] AR: مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا لِءَابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًۭا EN: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers.

folded.id: they|will|say there were three
folded.subject: They
folded.object: say there were three

spans.text: [22] AR: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَٰثَةٌۭ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌۭ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌۭ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ ۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا مِرَآءًۭ ظَٰهِرًۭا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ أَحَدًۭا EN: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog.

folded.id: they|will|stone you or return you to their religion
folded.subject: they
folded.object: stone you or return you to their religion

spans.text: [20] AR: إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا EN: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion.

folded.id: to which|is|the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious
folded.subject: to which
folded.object: the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious

spans.text: So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious.

folded.id: we have|made|that which is on the earth adornment for it that we may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed
folded.subject: We have
folded.object: that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed

spans.text: [7] AR: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا EN: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

folded.id: we would|have|certainly spoken
folded.subject: We would
folded.object: certainly spoken

spans.text: We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.

folded.id: we|caused|them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of allah is truth and that of the hour there is no doubt
folded.subject: We
folded.object: them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt

spans.text: [21] AR: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَآ إِذْ يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ ۖ فَقَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَٰنًۭا ۖ رَّبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًۭا EN: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt.

folded.id: we|have|remained a day or part of a day
folded.subject: We
folded.object: remained a day or part of a day

spans.text: They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day."

folded.id: we|will|make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground
folded.subject: We
folded.object: make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground

spans.text: [8] AR: وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًۭا جُرُزًا EN: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.

folded.id: we|will|surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid
folded.subject: We
folded.object: surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid

spans.text: Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."

folded.id: when you|have|withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than allah
folded.subject: when you
folded.object: withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah

spans.text: [16] AR: وَإِذِ ٱعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَأْوُۥٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًۭا EN: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah, retreat to the cave.
If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.

folded.id: which they|will|remain forever
folded.subject: which they
folded.object: remain forever

spans.text: [3] AR: مَّٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًۭا EN: In which they will remain forever

folded.id: who|has|sent down upon his servant the book and has not made therein any deviance
folded.subject: who
folded.object: sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.

folded.id: you|would|see the sun when it rose
folded.subject: you
folded.object: see the sun when it rose

spans.text: [17] AR: ۞ وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّۭا مُّرْشِدًۭا EN: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof.

folded.id: your lord|is|most knowing of how long you remained
folded.subject: Your Lord
folded.object: most knowing of how long you remained

spans.text: They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained.
Their Lord is most knowing about them."
Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number.

folded.id: your lord|will|spread out for you of his mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility
folded.subject: Your Lord
folded.object: spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility

spans.text: Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."
